## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Closing a debugging ledger with a validated root cause emits a draft...

The system SHALL ensure that closing a debugging ledger with a validated root cause emits a draft scenario whose signal_assertions reference the ledger's strongest signal.

#### Scenario: Closing a debugging ledger with a validated root cause emits a draft...

WHEN `draft-signal-asserting-scenarios-from-ledger` is implemented
THEN Closing a debugging ledger with a validated root cause emits a draft scenario whose signal_assertions reference the ledger's strongest signal.

### Requirement: The draft scenario validates against the gen-eval scenario schema

The system SHALL ensure that the draft scenario validates against the gen-eval scenario schema.

#### Scenario: The draft scenario validates against the gen-eval scenario schema

WHEN `draft-signal-asserting-scenarios-from-ledger` is implemented
THEN The draft scenario validates against the gen-eval scenario schema.

### Requirement: Closing a ledger without a validated root cause emits no draft scenario

The system SHALL ensure that closing a ledger without a validated root cause emits no draft scenario.

#### Scenario: Closing a ledger without a validated root cause emits no draft scenario

WHEN `draft-signal-asserting-scenarios-from-ledger` is implemented
THEN Closing a ledger without a validated root cause emits no draft scenario.
